descriptions: You can download a trial version of this app to try it for 15 minutes for free.
You won’t be charged anything when this free trial ends. You can’t make in-app purchases or use add-on content during this free trial, but you’ll keep any achievements you earn.

display_long_description:
**DodgeALL** is a high-intensity VR game that puts your agility and reflexes to the test. Engage in a world where the only rule is to dodge everything that comes your way! With immersive 3D environments and physics-based gameplay, each level presents a new challenge, offering endless replayability. Dodge, duck, dip, dive and crawl around in this adrenaline-fueled game, where your skill, speed and stamina determine your survival.

# Are you ready to DodgeALL?

# Features include:
- Mixed Reality Mode: Now available via a new campaign or in Party Mode.
- Party Mode: Play against friends & family using Android/iOS smartphones and tablets. Choose to be naughty or nice (or both). To join in, simply download the companion app "DodgeALL Party" for free from the app store.
- Room-scale & 360 degrees: Where you can move in your room is where you can move in the game. No fake movement: **No VR nausea here!**
- 3D Spatial Audio: Gives audible cues where obstacles are coming from.
- Abilities: 5 unlockable abilities to help when things get hot.
- Endless Mode: Play any unlocked level until you drop. Each iteration gets progressively faster.
- Leaderboards: Compare your dodging skills to other players.
- Twitch interactive mode: Let your viewers throw things at you!
- Bonus levels: New crazy challenges released regularly.
- Custom levels: Create your own levels (SideQuest required).

Join the Discord for questions, bugs, feedback or to give me ideas for new bonus levels: 
https://dodgeall.com/discord
